name: the_trim_extends_a_short_bar
why: ENTRY Z-C21.3 (the probe verdicts), finding L9-4 (= C5-4). The catalogue says taglia_membri trims the bars where they meet OR EXTENDS them until they touch. Up to library 0.141.0 it passed Options = 8 (the weld gap bit only) to InsertWeldmentTrimFeature2, and the only bench case was a cut. The Z-C21.3 probe of 28/9/2026 (typed Body2[] arrays, TUBO STRUTTURALE QUADRO 80X80X5, end condition Trim) measured: with a bar stopping 20 mm short of the other, Options 8 and 10 return a feature that is NOT in the tree and change nothing, 9 and 11 extend the bar to the face; with a bar entering the other, 8 and 11 cut the same -58798.23 mm3 while 15 (with the coped cut bit 4) cuts -57636.82. The guide gives the bits (swWeldmentTrimExtendOptionType_e: AllowTrimmedExtensionTrim 1, AllowTrimmingExtensionTrim 2, CopedCut 4, WeldGap 8). The library now passes 1 | 2 | 8 = 11.
defect_caught: Step 3 asks to trim a bar that does not reach the other one: it must be EXTENDED to the other's face. On library 0.141.0 SOLIDWORKS answers with a phantom feature, not in the tree, and the step is refused: red. The plain cut with the new Options is cut_shortens_the_bar, unchanged (the probe: 8 and 11 give the same cut).
_the_numbers: Measured by the probe on this very scene (TG): bar A (0,0,0)-(600,0,0), top face at Z 40; bar B (300,0,60)-(300,0,360), lower end at Z 60, 20 mm short of A. Before: 600 + 300 = 900 mm of tube, 1322960.17 mm3 (the same 900 x 1469.956 mm2 as the T of weld_bead_goes_between_touching_faces). With Options 11: B from Z 60 to Z 40, +29399.11 mm3 (20 mm x 1469.956 = 29399.12 by hand), volume 1352359.28, two bodies.

expect.tolerance_why: 900 mm of tube at 1469.956 mm2, as the probe read it before the trim; half a mm3 covers the rounding of the section with its corner radii
expect.why: the two bars do not touch yet: B stops 20 mm below A's top face

expect.tolerance_why: 20 mm x 1469.956 mm2, measured by the probe with Options 11 at the hundredth, as the cut of cut_shortens_the_bar; positive = added
expect.why: the bar is EXTENDED to the face, not left short and not cut

expect.tolerance_why: 1322960.17 + 29399.11, read from the part and not from the answer: the second reading of the same fact
